humanSteps: Owner allowed notifications for Threadspace Agent (production) and declined for Threadspace Agent Dev (development).
Owner allowed Threadspace to control Terminal (prompt attributed to the outer app; D-0003).
Owner enabled 'Allow notifications when mirroring or sharing the display' so banners are presented while the display is shared.
Owner clicked the presented banner for the final UI-quit test; the UI-open test used an accessibility press on the presented banner.

risks.risk: TCC attributes the login-item companion's Apple events to the containing app (D-0003). SPEC 13.5/18.9 assume the companion's own identity.
Overlay-titlebar drag regions require two core window permissions in office-local (D-0002).
macOS silences banners while the display is shared unless the user opts in; delivery remains in Notification Center.
SQLite runs synchronous=FULL with fullfsync off; the power-loss durability domain (F_FULLFSYNC) is not qualified.
A main-document reload retires subscriptions but does not yet recreate the office view; old-document connects are only epoch-guarded.
UI quit was exercised by terminating the UI process (SIGTERM) and companion-driven relaunch; menu Quit, crash and helper-kill relaunch are not exercised.
A companion launched by a notification response while not running (companion cold start) is not exercised.
The drag-region drag starts after an IPC round trip; pointer motion before the native drag loop starts is not followed.
Qualified only on macOS 27.2 with the Xcode 27 beta toolchain; behavior on macOS 26.x (the floor) is untested.
Release builds without the qualification feature compile and lint but were not natively exercised.

limitations: Notification permission prompts were answered against earlier builds of the same identities and signing certificate; the final binaries read the persisted decisions natively.
Fixture data is synthetic (provider 'synthetic', fixture ProcessKey); no Claude or Codex session was observed (M0B onward).
The office view is a deliberately simple geometric qualification scene, not product art.
redaction: Home-directory paths are written as ~; the signing certificate holder's name is removed; no prompt text, tool payloads or credentials exist in this evidence.
